attributes.action: Decide on the abolition of the Monarchy as it is no longer needed in 2026
attributes.additional_details: Abolishing the UK monarchy requires a parliamentary act following a referendum, potentially replacing the King with an elected head of state. It would also mean that there is more of a democracy than we have at present. The king is not democratically elected and could be seen as a dictator.
attributes.background: Abolition of the Monarchy would mean that money would be saved for other uses and bills would no longer need royal assent and could pass straight in to legislation.

rejection.details:
